❗ NEW VIDEO ANNOUNCEMENT — TOMORROW

CODE BLACK

At 8 PM, terrorists launch a brutal attack on a police station. A massive explosion destroys the entrance, triggering a city-wide Code Red.

The situation escalates rapidly. Police, SWAT, National Guard and emergency crews flood the area. Military headquarters assesses the threat and deploys armored units into the city.

Smoke and wreckage fill the streets as a mobile command center is established. The police station loses power and all cameras go offline.

The station is now completely surrounded.

SWAT enters first, but discovers traps and military-grade equipment inside. Seeing their wounded friends, the team is forced to withdraw.

Now it's the military's turn.

Armored vehicles advance as military units storm the building and the operation erupts into chaos. One suspect attempts to attack a soldier with a knife but is quickly restrained.

Outside, a field hospital is established while the entire city watches the crisis unfold on television.

Tonight, Hamburg will never be the same.

TO BE CONTINUED...
